title: Do student perceptions mirror reality? A mixed-methods study to evaluate the accuracy, utility and efficiency of AI-assisted feedback in introductory mathematics courses
summary: Two introductory mathematics courses were studied using Gemini 2.5 Pro to draft scores/feedback from submissions and course references. Study One compared human-only (159 students) with human-curated AI (89); Study Two compared AI, peer and professor feedback. Grades were broadly similar, but students rated professor feedback most useful and read AI feedback less often (57% vs 89%/94%). This is a specific educational study, bounded to two courses and short-term feedback rather than learning outcomes.
